activity_decision.evidence: In the ORIGINAL displacement plots, all three axes (N, E, U) show a clear, continuous trend change after day 365 relative to the blue-shaded normal prefix: N shifts downward and stabilizes at ~−2 mm; E accelerates downward from ~−5 mm to ~−11 mm over ~300 days; U shows a sustained dip to ~−4 mm followed by partial recovery but remains offset from pre-365 behavior. These are not isolated spikes or abrupt offsets but gradual, persistent deviations lasting hundreds of days—consistent with sustained displacement activity.
